# DAVx5 (with tasks.org or jtx Board) adding an account by base URL: the
# well-known redirect, discovery, a sync-collection with an empty token and a
# multiget of what it lists, then an incremental sync-collection with a limit.
# Written from published client behaviour (the DAVx5 manual's service
# discovery and synchronization pages, RFC 6578), not captured traffic.

### the well-known address
PROPFIND /.well-known/caldav
Depth: 0

<propfind xmlns="DAV:"><prop><current-user-principal/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 301
HEADER Location /dav/

### the context root
PROPFIND /dav/
Depth: 0

<propfind xmlns="DAV:"><prop><resourcetype/><displayname/><current-user-principal/><current-user-privilege-set/><calendar-home-set xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}current-user-principal 200 {principal}
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}displayname 404

### the principal
PROPFIND {principal}
Depth: 0

<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CAL="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><prop><CAL:calendar-home-set/><displayname/><CAL:calendar-user-address-set/><resourcetype/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set 200 {home}
PROP {principal} {DAV:}resourcetype 200 principal

### the home at depth 1
PROPFIND {home}
Depth: 1

<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CAL="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:ICAL="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><prop><resourcetype/><displayname/><ICAL:calendar-color/><CAL:calendar-description/><CAL:calendar-timezone/><current-user-privilege-set/><CAL:supported-calendar-component-set/><CS:source/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
PROP {assigned} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}supported-calendar-component-set 200 VTODO
PROP {assigned} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-description 200 Tasks assigned to bob
PROP {assigned} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}source 404
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}current-user-privilege-set 200 <d:read/>

### the collection before a sync
PROPFIND {assigned}
Depth: 0

<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><prop><CS:getctag/><sync-token/><supported-report-set/></prop></propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}supported-report-set 200 <d:sync-collection/>

### the first sync, with an empty token
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<sync-collection xmlns="DAV:"><sync-token/><sync-level>1</sync-level><prop><getetag/></prop></sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3
PROP {assigned}{done}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
SAVE token1 sync-token

### the objects it listed
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<CAL:calendar-multiget xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:CAL="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><prop><getcontenttype/><getetag/><CAL:calendar-data/></prop><href>{assigned}{open1}.ics</href><href>{assigned}{open2}.ics</href><href>{assigned}{done}.ics</href></CAL:calendar-multiget>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3
PROP {assigned}{done}.ics {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data 200 PERCENT-COMPLETE:100

### two tasks change in the browser
DO retitle open1

### and another is cancelled
DO cancel open2

### the incremental sync, a page of one
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<sync-collection xmlns="DAV:"><sync-token>{token1}</sync-token><sync-level>1</sync-level><limit><nresults>1</nresults></limit><prop><getetag/></prop></sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 2
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
STATUS {assigned} 507
SAVE token2 sync-token

### the rest of the changes
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<sync-collection xmlns="DAV:"><sync-token>{token2}</sync-token><sync-level>1</sync-level><prop><getetag/></prop></sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 1
STATUS {assigned}{open2}.ics 404

### a write while read-only
PUT {assigned}{open1}.ics
Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
If-Match: "anything"

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VTODO
UID:task-{open1}@tix
SUMMARY:ticked on the phone
STATUS:COMPLETED
END:VTODO
END:VCALENDAR
EXPECT 403
HAS need-privileges
